title: howto list
description: Every row the picker searches, from every collection: the tool registry, the cards, and the functions, aliases, git aliases, forgit shortcuts, tmux keys and zsh keys the shell defines. Sorted by collection, then name.

source.description: The collection the row came from, one of the names `howto find --source` accepts.

name.description: The row's identity in its collection, which `howto show` takes.

invocation.description: What to type to run it, which is not always the name: a registry key is often a package name.

description.description: What it does, empty where the collection says nothing.
